narrative.overview: MyEquator's visual identity reflects the physical, tactile world of footwear insole manufacturing in Bandung, West Java. It blends rugged industrial reliability with modern digital precision: deep vulcanized crimson (#8B0000), structured sizing breakdown matrices, high-contrast monospace ESC/P dot-matrix emulators, precision millimeter-scale CAD drafting grids, and crisp mechanical affordances.
keyCharacteristics: Crimson Brand Dominance: Dark Red (#8B0000) is the singular primary accent.
Physical Matrix Ergonomics: Sizing matrices (EU 36–48) are structured tabular grids.
CAD & CNC Vector Precision: Parametric insole splines with millimeter caliper controls and AutoCAD R12 DXF layer streaming.
Industrial Terminal Evocation: Continuous form printing features authentic CRT phosphor green previews.

rules.name: The Singular Accent Rule
rules.body: Deep crimson (#8B0000) is used on ≤10% of any view. Its rarity guarantees immediate visual hierarchy for primary CTAs and active states.

rules.name: The Matched Hue Rule
rules.body: Status badges and alerts always pair text and background from the same color family (e.g., text-blue-700 on bg-blue-50).

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All dynamic numbers, footwear sizes, currency amounts, and order codes must specify tabular-nums or font-mono with OpenType tnum enabled.

rules.name: The Inset Indicator Rule
rules.body: Active list items and selected tabs use an inset indicator bar rather than a thick left border, completely preventing box-sizing displacement.

dos: Do format all currency in Indonesian Rupiah with thousand-separator dots: Rp 1.250.000.
Do include Indonesian Terbilang spelled-out text on printable Delivery Orders and Invoices.
Do use tabular-nums on all footwear quantities, sizes, prices, dates, and caliper dimensions.
Do ensure all mobile action buttons satisfy minimum 44px touch targets.
Do guard multi-field forms against accidental loss with isDirty discard confirmations.
donts: Don't use generic floating decorative gradients or rainbow AI accents.
Don't place dark gray text on saturated background colors (gray-on-color).
Don't use native browser alert() or window.confirm() popups; use accessible in-app modals.
Don't use pulse/ping animations on status badges; keep status indicators calm and static.
Don't apply border-left-4 on list cards; use inset indicator bars to avoid layout shifts.
